description: Multiplies or divides a phase ramp with no phase jack of its own: it takes the ramp from the ZZC clock module standing beside it.

params.text: Sets the whole-number factor, -199 to 199; positive numbers run the output faster and negative numbers slower, and the display shows the number with a sign for which.
Holds a change of factor back until the phase reaches a boundary the new factor lines up with, so the output stays in step with its source; the display blinks while a change is pending.
Chooses whether the phase is taken from the module on the left or the module on the right; a lamp lights for the side in use, and only while a ZZC clock module is actually there.

inputs.text: Scales the factor by a factor of two for every volt, and the result is rounded back to a whole number or to one over a whole number.

outputs.text: A square held high through the first half of each output cycle, or a 1ms 10V trigger at the start of it when Gate Mode is turned off.
The multiplied or divided phase ramp, 0V to 10V per cycle.

notes: This module has no phase input and no reset input, and does nothing at all until a Clock, Divider, Div or another Div (Expander) is placed immediately to its left or its right.
The switch on the panel chooses which of the two sides the phase is taken from, and the reset arrives over the same connection.
Several of these can be chained in a row, each adding its own phase to what it passes along, so Target transport source can pick out a module further down the row.
menu: Gate Mode — holds the CLK output high through the first half of each output cycle instead of firing a 1ms trigger at the start of it; this module comes up with it on
Target transport source: Clock, Divider, Div, Div (Expander) — picks whose phase is taken from the chosen side; where no module of that sort has put a phase there, nothing drives this one

inputs.0:
bipolar · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads the knob setting alone.
